release_notes: SSL Timeout Fixes - Improved HTTP/HTTPS connectivity for GitHub updates
changelog: ✅ Fixed SSL/TLS certificate verification timeout for GitHub connections
✅ Increased HTTP connection timeout to 60 seconds
✅ Increased HTTP read timeout to 120 seconds
✅ Fixed compatibility for both HTTP and HTTPS protocols
✅ Added proper SSL option handling with withOptions()
✅ Applied fixes to all GitHub API calls (metadata, version list, sequential check)
✅ Better error handling for network timeouts
